$comment: Single source of truth for labels used by ALL engines (CoreML, gliner25-rs, torch). Entities: OntoNotes 5.0 subset; `label` is the natural-language prompt sent to GLiNER, `ontonotes` the tag it maps back to. Relations: a small ACE 2005 subset (canonical type + argument typing) cross-referenced to Wikidata properties (FewRel/T-REx/Shimorina-DB compatible). `name` is the canonical output id; `prompt` is the text sent to the model (wording is an experiment knob). Relations are grouped into `pass`es of <= 4 because the CoreML relation head is R4 and the bucket is Q<=8; every engine runs the same passes. `head`/`tail` are OntoNotes types for typed decoding (JointIE) or post-filtering. Direction follows ACE Arg1->Arg2 / Wikidata subject->object; `wikidata_inverse: true` means the Wikidata property points tail->head. Descriptions are not sent to the model (they overflow the 128-token bucket).
